sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Through Secretary Home And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Afzal,Mohammad Anas Raza

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Avnish Kumar Srivastava,Gyan Mani Singh Chauhan
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Mr. Avnish Kumar Srivastava has filed Vakalatnama as well as short counter affidavit in the Court today.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
3.

By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants have prayed for quashing the entire proceedings as well as the prosecution of the Applicants under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act which is pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 1, Meerut, as Criminal Case No. 21619 of 2021 (arising out of Crime Neeraj Malik And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. Through Secretary Home And ... on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17061981/
1 No. 526 of 2018), State versus Neeraj Malik & others.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 1, Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. It has been contended by learned counsel for the applicants that the applicant no. 1 and opposite party no. 3 are husband and wife and they have amicably settled their dispute and entered into a compromise and the learned Magistrate verified the compromise entered into between the parties vide order dated 09.06.2023, copy of which has been annexed as annexure no. 8 to the present application, hence the proceeding against the applicants be quashed.
5. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.3 has admitted the fact of the compromise and submitted that the applicants and opp. party No. 3 have compromised the dispute and as such opp.
party No. 3 does not want to press the present case against the applicants.

6. Hence, considering the facts and circumstances of the case and nature of offence, the proceeding under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. & 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act bearing Criminal Case No.
21619 of 2021 (arising out of Crime No. 526 of 2018), State versus Neeraj Malik & others, is hereby quashed.
7. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application stands allowed.
